prompts.name: odysseus
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: realistic marble-statue-inspired transparent cutout for the Prophecy of FaZe esports website. Photoreal museum sculpture photography, weathered ivory marble with fine chisel marks, gentle antique-gold edge light, deep sculptural shadows, elegant and cinematic. Truly transparent background and clean alpha edges, not a black or white backdrop and not a checkerboard drawing. Render the sculpture at full opacity; the website will fade it to 10–20%. One isolated subject, no text, logos, watermark, frame, scenery, or painted illustration. Modest classical drapery. Keep the silhouette and attributes inside the image with breathing room. Odysseus, mature bearded Greek voyager wearing a draped cloak and an ancient Greek pilos cap, holding a bow low across his body. Three-quarter statue from head to knees, composed tall, turned slightly toward the left with a thoughtful determined expression. The bow and cloak should identify the wandering hero. No helmet, modern clothing, extra limbs, or other figures.
